newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends up on followthrough, Thai floods.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends up on followthrough, Thai floods.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on followthrough from Friday with concern about the fate of Thailand's rice crop also cited, traders said.
"It was followthrough from Friday's up day," a trader said. "There continue to be reports of flooding in Thailand."
Traders also said the market was buoyed by a lack of farmer selling and cited resistance in the January contract at $10.12 to $10.17 per cwt.
Rice closed 10 to 12 cents per cwt higher, with November up 11 cents per cwt at $9.96.
